job.title: Personal Tax Senior / Senior Tax Accountant
job.description:
Are you an experienced personal tax professional looking for a role where you can take ownership of your clients while still having the support of an experienced tax team around you?

We're working with a well-established independent accountancy practice in Leeds to recruit a Personal Tax Senior / Senior Tax Accountant.

We're deliberately keeping an open mind on job titles and qualifications. You might currently be working as a Personal Tax Senior, Tax Senior, Tax Adviser, Tax Accountant or Assistant Manager – or perhaps you're an experienced practice accountant whose role includes a significant amount of personal tax.

What matters most is that you have good hands-on personal tax experience gained within accountancy practice and are comfortable dealing directly with clients.

The role

You'll take responsibility for a varied portfolio of personal tax clients, including individuals, company directors and clients of the wider accounts team.

A large part of the role is personal tax compliance. You'll manage the Self Assessment process from start to finish, obtaining information from clients, preparing accurate returns, dealing with queries and making sure deadlines are met.

You'll have support from experienced senior colleagues when you need it, while having the autonomy to manage your own clients and workload.

Depending on your existing experience, you'll also have the opportunity to become involved in trusts, estates, partnerships, Capital Gains Tax and more complex tax matters.

There is advisory work within the team too. You don't need to arrive as an advisory tax specialist – the important thing is having strong compliance foundations and the ability to recognise when a client's circumstances may require further tax advice.

What you'll be doing

  • Managing your own portfolio of personal tax clients
  • Preparing and submitting Self Assessment tax returns
  • Taking ownership of the tax return process from start to finish
  • Liaising directly with clients and HMRC
  • Reviewing tax calculations, coding notices, statements and repayments
  • Dealing with Capital Gains Tax matters where appropriate
  • Preparing trust, estate and partnership returns depending on your experience
  • Identifying potential tax issues and opportunities for further advice
  • Working alongside the Tax Manager and Tax Partners on more complex matters
  • Building strong, long-term client relationships
  • Supporting more junior members of the team where appropriate
  • Managing deadlines and your own workload effectively
  • Assisting with new client onboarding and relevant AML requirements

What we're looking for

We're interested in speaking to people with solid personal tax experience gained within an accountancy practice.

You don't necessarily need to be CTA qualified and we're not looking for somebody who already knows absolutely everything.

You could be a strong Personal Tax Senior looking for your next move, an experienced Tax Adviser wanting more responsibility, an Assistant Manager who still enjoys hands-on client work, or a practice accountant whose experience has included significant responsibility for personal tax.

Ideally, you'll have:

  • Several years' personal tax experience within accountancy practice
  • Good practical knowledge of Self Assessment and personal tax compliance
  • Experience managing your own clients or taking significant responsibility for a portfolio
  • Confidence communicating directly with clients
  • The ability to organise your workload and work to tax deadlines
  • A proactive and professional approach

Experience of trusts, estates, partnerships, CGT or tax planning would be useful, but we don't expect every candidate to have experience across every area.

ACA, ACCA, CTA, ATT or similar qualifications would be welcomed, but relevant practical experience is equally important.

What's on offer?

  • Salary up to £50,000 depending on experience
  • One day per week working from home
  • Free on-site parking
  • Established and supportive tax team
  • Direct client responsibility and genuine autonomy
  • Opportunity to broaden your technical tax experience
  • Exposure to advisory work alongside experienced Tax Managers and Partners
  • Ongoing professional development
  • Friendly, independent practice environment

Location: Leeds, within easy reach of the city centre
Job Type: Permanent, Full Time

If you've built good personal tax experience in practice but aren't sure whether you tick every box, we'd still be very happy to have a conversation.

Due to the amount of response we receive, unfortunately we are not able to give feedback to individuals. If you have not heard back within 5 days, please assume that you have not been successful for the role you have applied for.

By applying to this advertisement, you are hereby giving consent for Jo Holdsworth Recruitment to hold your details for a 30-day period and contact you via any method of contact you have listed on your application.

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
Jo Holdsworth Recruitment are excited to be recruiting a Business Development Manager for an established Leeds-based professional services business.

 

This is a confidential opportunity within a growing organisation. You’ll take ownership of new business development, strategic partnerships and long-term client relationships across the UK.

 

The role

 

You’ll identify new commercial opportunities and build relationships with professional partners and key decision-makers.

 

You’ll create a focused sales plan, develop a strong pipeline and support the business’s wider growth strategy.

 

You’ll also represent the business at networking events and industry conferences across the UK.

 

Key responsibilities

 

  • Identify and secure new business opportunities
  • Build long-term relationships with referral partners
  • Create and deliver a clear sales strategy
  • Research market trends and competitor activity
  • Manage and report on your sales pipeline
  • Attend industry events and networking opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and operational teams
  • Support a positive client experience throughout the sales process

 

What we’re looking for

 

You’ll have proven experience across business development, sales or account management.

 

You’ll know how to build trust, open new conversations and turn relationships into commercial opportunities.

 

Experience within property, financial services or another partnership-led sector would support your application.

 

You’ll also bring

 

  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • A commercial and strategic mindset
  • Confidence managing senior stakeholder relationships
  • Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills
  • Experience using CRM systems
  • A track record of achieving sales targets
  • The ability to work independently

 

Location and travel

 

The role is based in Leeds and requires travel across the UK. Regular access to the Leeds office would be advantageous.

 

Please note that due to the volume of applications received, we are unable to provide individual feedback. If you have not heard back within 5 days, please assume your application has been unsuccessful. By applying for this role, you consent to Jo Holdsworth Recruitment holding your details for a 30-day period and contacting you via any method provided.

job.title: Sales Executive
job.description:
Are you a confident communicator who enjoys building relationships and helping people make important decisions?

We are recruiting on behalf of a leading international healthcare organisation seeking a Patient Sales Consultant to join their growing Leeds-based team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a background in sales, business development, customer success or account management who enjoys a consultative approach and thrives on building trust with customers.

The Role

As the first point of contact for prospective patients, you will guide individuals through the services available, taking the time to understand their needs and helping them make informed decisions. Due to the nature of the role, empathy and compassion are just as important as commercial awareness.

Key Responisibilities

  • Managing inbound enquiries from prospective patients
  • Conducting consultations over the phone to understand individual requirements
  • Building rapport and trust with customers from a variety of backgrounds
  • Providing tailored information and treatment options
  • Following up quotations and progressing opportunities through the sales process
  • Managing the customer journey from initial enquiry through to appointment booking
  • Taking payments and maintaining accurate records
  • Using technology and AI-powered tools to enhance customer experience and sales performance
  • Working towards individual and team targets

Experience/ Skill Set and/or Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a sales, business development, lead generation, customer success or account management role (desirable)
  • Confident and professional telephone manner
  • Comfortable following up opportunities and converting enquiries into sales
  • Compassionate and able to handle sensitive conversations with empathy
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills
  • Organised, proactive and target-driven
  • Confident using technology, with an interest in AI and modern sales tools
  • Resilient with a positive and professional approach

Contract Information
  • Salary: £28,000 - £30,000 annually DOE plus monthly commission / bonus
  • Location: Leeds City Centre - fully on site
  • Working Hours: Monday to Friday, with working hours scheduled between 8:00am and 6:00pm. Approximately 1 in 3 Saturday mornings will be worked from home, with time off in lieu provided.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation where you can combine your sales ability with a genuine passion for helping people.
